system.effect:
You become Trained in Awareness. Once per round, when a living creature you can perceive within 15 feet takes a Wound or becomes Spent, you may capture a Death Echo (maximum one held; it fades at encounter end). Before rolling one of your own Strikes or damaging Casts, you may expend the Echo: if that Attack Hits, add +2 damage to one creature Hit. This cannot trigger from summoned manifestations or from your own voluntary Vigor loss.

If this is your first Calling, you also gain 6 Vigor and Training in Elementalism, or Forceweaving, Vitalism, Mindweaving, or Spiritcraft.

NEEDS Expert/Master/Legendary increases.
